adjudication.depicted_input: Shared MUPAD multimodal input interface showing Image/Text/RNA guidance into multimodal DiT blocks, plus the noisy-latent-to-clean-image generation path and decoupled cross-modal attention for the three modalities.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible under the atlas rules because it directly depicts the immediate model-facing input mechanism for multiple listed routes: text, RNA, and image modalities are explicitly shown as guidance channels entering MUPAD, and the inset shows the route-specific cross-modal attention interface. A shared architecture crop may support multiple named variants from the same paper when they use the same depicted mechanism, and training routes are in scope. This supports the text-conditioned and RNA-conditioned routes, including paired pretraining and generation variants. The broader top-panel crop would be more conceptual, but it is not required because the current crop already shows the model input interface clearly.
